title: ConsensusLLM: An LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Consensus Seeking Framework

defines.name: ConsensusLLM
defines.definition: An LLM-driven multi-agent framework for consensus seeking through inter-agent negotiation and iterative state adjustment.

problem: LLM-driven multi-agent consensus behavior is not well understood, making it unclear how agents reach agreement and what factors affect convergence or failure.
